decisions.reason: As a flagship product line close to the core software business, it likely still has unresolved upside, strong strategic fit, and enough potential to justify keeping the option open.
The education institute extends customer relationships and complements the installed software base, so its modest uncertainty and likely manageable carrying costs favor continuation.
A remote support tool fits tightly with the firm's service model and should be inexpensive to maintain, making it a useful option to retain.
Practice analytics is a natural extension of practice management software and, in a growing digital market, still offers enough learning and cross-selling value to stay on the market.
A complete practice bundle is very close to the established offer and likely strengthens customer acquisition and lock-in, so abandonment is unlikely.

Because the portal is relatively distant from the firm's core capabilities and customer workflow software, its strategic fit is weaker and management is more likely to reallocate resources away from it.
